name: DeepSeek Harness for Win v1.0.6
body:
## Features / 主要更新

- Update notices now appear as a compact centered banner below the title bar and are destroyed after seven seconds or dismissal. / 更新通知改为标题栏下方居中的紧凑横幅，7 秒或关闭后销毁。
- A per-version Do not remind me again action persists the ignored version and clears the main-process notice cache. / 新增按版本不再提示，会持久化忽略版本并清空主进程通知缓存。
- The native sidebar logo is branded blue and opens the desktop menu when expanded; the collapsed state keeps left-click sidebar expansion and adds right-click menu access. / 原生侧边栏 Logo 染为品牌蓝，展开态左键打开桌面菜单，收起态保留左键展开并支持右键打开菜单。

## Improvements / 优化提升

- The desktop menu follows the native logo position and stays within the viewport instead of reserving a separate floating trigger. / 桌面菜单跟随原生 Logo 位置打开并适配窗口边缘，不再预留独立浮动触发器。
- The compact notice layout adapts to narrow windows and reduced-motion preferences. / 紧凑通知横幅适配小窗口和减少动态效果设置。

## Fixes / 修复

- Duplicate logo overlap and stale folded notification nodes are removed from the desktop shell. / 移除重复 Logo 遮挡和过期折叠通知节点。
- Dismissed notices no longer reappear for the same version after a refresh. / 同版本不再提示在刷新后不再重复弹出。
